messages:
Lina M: Quick Q for SF offsite travelers: anyone allergic to nuts? planning to pack a communal snack box for the train/meetups.
Owen K: No allergies here. Great idea! Also - does People Ops cover carbon offsets if we fly?
Priya S: Reimbursed offsets last company trip when I uploaded the receipt to Expensr. check travel policy page.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Travel policy updated 2025-06-12. Offsets are reimbursable with proof of purchase.
Tom B: I'll probably fly. Can we organize a luggage drop at the venue? redwood folks usually have late flights.
Lina M: thinking of a small labeled shelf near the conference room for checked day-bags. No sharp items, obvious stuff only.
Owen K: Also vote: carry-on only challenge? whoever packs only carry-on gets dibs on the snack box first :P
Priya S: 525 Carry-on challenge accepted.
Tom B: 644 tempted but I have camera gear :/
Lina M: Poll: react with 6eb for Carry-on, 6ec for Checked bag, 9f3 for Need special handling (camera/fragile).
Owen K: 6eb
Priya S: 6eb
Tom B: 9f3
people-ops-bot: Event 'SF Offsite Logistics' added to the calendar 2025-08-03.
